questions.answer: In a pure inductor the current lags the voltage by 90 degrees.

questions.answer: A MOSFET's channel is controlled by gate voltage; a BJT is current-controlled.

questions.answer: $AB+AC$ is a sum of product terms (SOP); it is not standard (canonical) since not every term has all variables.

questions.question_text: The input X-NOR gate gives high output
options: When one input is high and other is low
Only when both inputs are low
Only when both the inputs are high
questions.answer: XNOR outputs 1 when both inputs are equal.

questions.question_text: Which of the following motor is more suitable for EV applications?
questions.answer: BLDC motors have high efficiency and power density, so they suit EVs.

questions.question_text: In LVDT, when the iron core is exactly at centre, then net output of transducer is
questions.answer: At the centre the two secondary voltages are equal and opposite, so the net output is zero.

questions.answer: Strain gauges measure strain from load, so they are used for structural load testing.

questions.question_text: Which transducer is used for light spectrum detection?
questions.answer: A phototransistor senses light and converts it to an electrical signal.

questions.question_text: Earth wire is made up of

questions.question_text: The most widely used material for solar cell fabrication is
questions.answer: Silicon is the most widely used because of its bandgap, abundance and mature technology.
